claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a solar panel array only; no battery is shown, and no charge-test result is visible.
No battery or repair history documentation is shown in the witness report.

claims.claim: Contact us for ur Solar Energy Solution...
claims.evidence: This is generic marketing text; no specific item details are provided in the report.

risks.risk: Panel wattage/rating is unknown, so the value could be far lower than expected.
risks.proof: A clear close-up of the panel label/sticker showing wattage (W), voltage/current (Vmp/Imp), and model number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unverified/unknown-capacity used solar module (worst-case rating), with no performance guarantee.

risks.risk: Condition is unknown (micro-cracks, delamination, water ingress, scratches) which can reduce output and lifespan.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of the full panel surface and edges, plus a photo of the junction box/backsheet area showing any damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with potential defects (worst-case), assuming reduced performance and no warranty.

risks.risk: Brand/model/serial number is not visible, making authenticity and compatibility uncertain.
risks.proof: Photo of the manufacturer label/serial number (front or back) with readable text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown brand used panel with uncertain specs.

risks.risk: Electrical interface and mounting hardware may be missing or degraded (junction box, MC4 connectors, cable length, frame rails).
risks.proof: Photos of the junction box, connector type (e.g., MC4), cable length, and frame/mounting holes/rails.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/uncertain accessories, requiring possible replacement parts.

risks.risk: It may be part of a larger system (multiple panels) or a single panel; quantity affects total value.
risks.proof: A wide shot showing the full setup and count of panels, or a photo listing number of panels included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a single panel/module only (worst-case quantity).

risks.risk: Battery claims cannot be verified; if the battery is not included or is lower capacity/older, total system value drops.
risks.proof: Photos of the battery model/label (Ah/Wh, voltage), and a screenshot/video of a charge test showing it holds charge for the stated duration.
risks.if_unproven: Price the deal as solar panel only; treat any battery as not included or not proven.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the solar panel rating label (wattage and model) and serial number (readable).
Close-up photos of the panel surface and edges to check for cracks/micro-cracks/delamination/water ingress.
Photos of the junction box and connectors (MC4 type) and the cable length.
A wide shot showing whether it’s a single panel or multiple panels, and the total count included.
If a battery is included: photos of the battery label (voltage and capacity) and a video/screenshot of the charge test showing it holds charge for the stated duration.
response.reason: The witness report identifies a solar panel array but does not show the wattage/model, condition details, or any battery evidence. Without at least the panel rating and condition proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
